text.p: Access Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to request shareholder approval for a one-for-four reverse stock split.

The company said it believes that a reverse split will position Access more attractively with institutional investors and investment community members which generally have restrictions on investing in unlisted companies. In addition, the company intends immediately to submit application for a listing on the NASDAQ SmallCap market. The company said it believes that securing a NASDAQ listing along with the reverse split will improve Access' ability to finance the company's research activities under more favorable terms.
